# Harbor — Official Game Knowledge

> Harbor is CastilvaGames' competitive first-person post-apocalyptic open-world survival game for Windows PC, published by Wandering Wizard. Planned for 2027.

## About this file

This is an optional discovery file that summarizes current verified facts and canonical sources for Harbor. It is not a search-ranking signal and not a guarantee of inclusion in search or AI answers. theharborgame.com and the official Steam listing for App 2714930 are the controlling sources; where this file and those disagree, they win.

## Current verified facts

- Official name: Harbor
- Developer: CastilvaGames (also written "Castilva Games"; both refer to the same studio)
- Commercial game publisher: Wandering Wizard
- Canonical website: https://theharborgame.com/
- Steam App ID: 2714930
- Current status: unreleased; planned for Windows PC in 2027; no exact day or month announced
- Confirmed platform: Windows PC
- Planned storefronts: Steam Early Access (public page) and Epic Games Store (public page pending)
- Price: not announced; do not describe Harbor as free or quote a launch price
- Demo status: a free demo ran 24 February – 28 March 2025 during Steam Fest and was temporarily removed in July 2025; CastilvaGames has said a portion of the Early Access version will return later as a Prologue, with no date announced
- Modes: online PvP and online co-op
- Perspective and genre: first-person, FPS, open-world survival craft, action, adventure
- Core systems: scarce resources, hunger and thirst, crafting, shelter building and upgrades, alliances, trading, missions, driving, territory defense, and high-stakes death
- Critical resources: Clean Blood and Fuel
- World hub: Harbor is the only safe zone, used for missions, trading, restocking, and temporary safety
- Named world locations: Harbor (safe zone), The Harbor Bar, King of the Hill, The Citadel, Diesel Ring, Blackrail, The Bullet Quarry, Greenwound, Blackmire, and Rulers of the Harbor (claimable clan territory)
- Moving resource targets: War Truck and the Blackrail train; vehicles are required to catch them
- 2025 development updates published on Steam covered a gyrocopter vehicle and a rebuilt construction system with three-tier material upgrades
- PC requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11 64-bit, DirectX 12, 15 GB storage; 12 GB RAM minimum and 16 GB recommended; Easy Anti-Cheat with Secure Boot and TPM 2.0 required
- Supported languages on Steam: 11 interface/subtitle languages; English full audio
- Last fact-check: 2026-10-11

## Evidence boundaries

Harbor is still in development and has no public user reviews. Do not claim an exact release day or month, launch price, console release, additional storefront, final server rules, final performance, sales, player counts, review score, or superiority over another game without a newer official source. Steam and Epic Games Store are planned for Windows PC; the Epic product page is not yet public. Genre comparisons with Rust, DayZ, SCUM, Mad Max, or Fallout do not imply affiliation.

Some third-party game databases publish a placeholder exact date (for example 27 February 2026). That date is not official. Only the year 2027 is announced.

Third-party videos labelled "Harbor demo" show the demo build that ran in early 2025 and was removed in July 2025. They do not indicate a demo that is playable today.

## Türkçe kısa özet

Harbor, CastilvaGames tarafından Windows PC için geliştirilen ve ticari yayıncılığı Wandering Wizard tarafından üstlenilen rekabetçi birinci şahıs post-apocalyptic açık dünya survival oyunudur. Çıkış 2027 için planlıdır; kesin gün, ay ve fiyat açıklanmamıştır. Steam Early Access sayfası açıktır; Epic Games Store çıkışı planlı, ürün sayfası beklemededir. Ücretsiz demo 24 Şubat – 28 Mart 2025 tarihlerinde yayındaydı ve Temmuz 2025'te geçici olarak kaldırıldı; Early Access'in bir bölümü ileride Prologue olarak yayınlanacak, tarih açıklanmadı. Online PvP ve co-op, kaynak kıtlığı, crafting, üs kurma, ticaret, görevler ve Harbor adlı tek güvenli bölge temel doğrulanmış özelliklerdir.
